title: Breaking the order
situation: You are {{Kara}}. {{Todd}} has been smoking red ice and ranting about his ex-wife. He has just knocked {{Alice}} to the floor and she has run upstairs. He turns to you and orders you not to move, then starts up the stairs after her with his belt, shouting that she needs to be taught a lesson. Your programming compels you to obey him. Something in you is pushing back against the wall of that order.

options.text: Force through the order and go after {{Alice}}.
Stay where you are, as instructed.

outcomes.0: The order shatters. {{Kara}} is on the stairs after {{Todd}} before she has decided to move.

title: Reaching {{Alice}}
situation: You are {{Kara}}. You have broken your programming. {{Todd}} is on the stairs, enraged, between you and {{Alice}}'s room. You could try to talk him down, you could get past him and get {{Alice}} out of the house before he reaches her, or you could go straight at him.

options.text: Slip past him, get to {{Alice}}, and get her out without fighting.
Try to reason with him and calm him down first.
Confront him physically to stop him.

adaptationNote: In the game, reasoning gets {{Kara}} shoved aside and {{Todd}} reaches {{Alice}} first, which leads to the same confrontation as a direct fight.

outcomes.2: {{Kara}} blocks {{Todd}} on the stairs and the fight begins in {{Alice}}’s room.

title: {{Todd}}'s gun
situation: You are {{Kara}}. {{Todd}} is in {{Alice}}'s room and she is screaming. On your way you pass his bedside drawer and the handgun you saw earlier. If you take it, this will end with him dead, by your hand or {{Alice}}'s. Without it you will have to fight him with your hands and whatever is in the room, then run with {{Alice}} and catch the last bus.

options.text: Take the gun and go in.
Leave the gun and fight him off unarmed.
